title: Pure Power Patron
summary: Power Patron cards with Medius the Pure and the Theorealize Spells that feed them, plus generic staples. The page's combo lines add the new Ars Magna cards, so they use cards this list leaves out. The Level 1 Artmage, DoomZ and Elfnote Power Patrons stay out too, since each one locks the Extra Deck to a single card type. Medius searches a Shade Power Patron, and each Shade banishes the top three cards of the Deck to bring out its Patron: Nerva, Jupiter or Junora. With all three out, Vidolium returns them for its GY wipe. Mediclius, the newest card, is a Link-3 that negates and halves their monsters and banishes their whole field once it points to three.
main: Medius the Pure
Summoned: adds or summons a Power Patron monster from the Deck; revives itself from the GY.
Theorealized Medius
Newest support. Counts as Power Patron: summons itself while a Power Patron card is out and searches a Theorealize card.
Nervedo the Shadebeast Power Patron
Banishes the top three to become Nerva; face-up in the Extra Deck, summons a Power Patron from the Deck.
Jupredo the Shademachine Power Patron
Banishes the top three to become Jupiter; face-up in the Extra Deck, searches a Power Patron Spell/Trap.
Junoldo the Shadespirit Power Patron
Banishes the top three to become Junora; face-up in the Extra Deck, returns a Power Patron card.
Vidolium the Unstable Power Patron of Unity
Returns a Fusion, Synchro and Xyz to summon itself and banish both GYs.
Prohibited Power Patron Portal - Terminus
Limited. Sends a Power Patron to the GY and searches a DARK Fairy such as Medius.
Plundered Power Patron Plane - Vidolia
Field Spell: reveals a Patron to add or summon the Shade that names it.
Prohibitive Power Patron Purview - Vilaea
With Nerva, Jupiter and Junora to show, your Power Patron effects can't be answered.
Theorealize Liberation
With Medius out, adds or summons a 300/200 Shade from the Deck.
Theorealize Overdrive
Revives Medius from the GY or banishment; later sets a monster's Level.
Theorealize Past Lull
With a Shade out (each counts as Artmage, DoomZ or Elfnote), summons Medius with no response.
Theorealize
Sends Medius to the GY and stacks the top of the opponent's Deck.
Power Patron Shade of the Final Hour
Summons a Power Patron, then banishes more the more card types you control.
extra: Newest support. Link-3 with an Extra Deck monster: negates and halves their monsters, and banishes their field when it points to three.
Nerva the Power Patron of Creation
Fusion Patron that Nervedo becomes; turns an Artmage effect into a board wipe.
Jupiter the Power Patron of Destruction
Xyz Patron that Jupredo becomes; 6500 ATK with an Xyz under it.
Junora the Power Patron of Tuning
Synchro Patron that Junoldo becomes; summoned, negates their face-up cards.
Link-2: searches a Theorealize card, and Link Summons again on either Main Phase.
